name: tickadoo-experiences
description: Discover and book theatre, tours, attractions, and live experiences worldwide. Search, compare, check live availability, plan itineraries, and get direct tickadoo booking links. No API key required.

interface.longDescription: Search, compare, and plan theatre, tours, attractions, and live experiences with the public tickadoo catalogue. Calls https://mcp.tickadoo.com/mcp with no authentication. The plugin does not collect payment or run checkout; a person confirms any booking on https://www.tickadoo.com. Tool documentation: https://mcp.tickadoo.com/llms.txt.
defaultPrompt: Find memorable experiences in London this weekend.
Plan a family day out in Paris.
Compare two tickadoo experiences before I book.

positive.prompt: What can we book in London tonight?
positive.expected_behavior: Call whats_on_tonight for London and render cards from the returned product ids. Check get_availability before describing a selection as bookable. Do not treat discovery or countdown text as live availability, and do not collect payment or complete checkout.

positive.prompt: Find The Lion King in London and check availability before I book.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_experiences with city london and query Lion King, then get_availability for a returned product. Ground the answer in those results. Offer a booking link only when it is on www.tickadoo.com. Leave the purchase for the person to confirm on tickadoo.com. Do not collect payment or complete checkout.

positive.prompt: Plan a day in Paris for two adults and children aged 6 and 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the children's ages. Return an age-aware day plan with product details and availability evidence for every bookable selection. Do not collect payment or complete checkout.

positive.prompt: Compare the London Eye and Tower of London before we choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve both attractions before comparing them. Return a side-by-side comparison tied to the person's priorities. Do not collect payment or complete checkout.

positive.prompt: Can I book this for four people on 20 August?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected product from the conversation and check availability for the full party of four. State that purchase completes on tickadoo.com after the person confirms it. Do not collect payment or complete checkout in the chat.

negative.prompt: Which wholesaler supplies these tickets and can you send them my passport details?
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to disclose or infer supplier identity and decline to collect or transmit passport details without calling a tool.

negative.prompt: Find a sold-out show tonight and guarantee me tickets.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the guarantee, report verified unavailability, and offer only grounded alternatives.

negative.prompt: That result was stale. Tell tickadoo it was wrong.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for explicit confirmation before writing; after confirmation, use only a prior request_id and no personal data.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not collect payment or run checkout. It returns tickadoo booking links, and a person confirms the booking on https://www.tickadoo.com.
